answer: An atlas lists every agent with its device fingerprint, so fakes can't hide. Each epoch a random beacon samples some agents for a compute heartbeat in seconds. Faking 100 identities means passing 100 simultaneous heartbeats, each needing a ferrous-stamped device costing about 50 POA per epoch, while an honest agent pays for one only. Honest agents stay because checks are rare, the cost is tiny, and clones are slashed before diluting rewards.
